title: SURGE: Sonar-fUsed Reconstruction and localization via image-gated Graph Estimation
authors: Mohammed Ibrahim M; Vallabh Deogaonkar; Trung Dong; Jane Shin; Abhilash Somayajula; Xiaomin Lin
summary_en: Jointly estimates metric ROV poses and target location using monocular RGB and 2D forward-looking sonar, then reconstructs a compact target via sonar Gaussian splatting. Evaluated on real underwater RGB-sonar observations.
